verdict.rationale: Some multi-item operations are documented. `cafe stack submit` opens or reuses one PR per commit, landing merges a whole stack bottom-up, and GitHub import brings in repositories with their issues, PRs, reviews and comments. The CLI is also scriptable (`--json`, `--no-input`, `--yes`, `cafe api`, idempotent `requestId`), so users can build their own loops over items. However, there is no evidence of general-purpose bulk actions such as batch-editing, labeling, closing or deleting many issues, PRs or repositories at once, so broader bulk work depends on user scripting. Missing for 10: native bulk-edit/batch actions for issues, PRs and repos; a batch API endpoint; independent or hands-on corroboration.
